results.title: Chunk-Parallel Scanning of Line-Delimited RDF
results.abstract: We present a chunk-parallel scanner for N-Triples that splits the input on record boundaries and parses each chunk independently. Blank-node and prefix scope is handled per chunk. The approach avoids a custom parser and reuses an existing tokenizer.

results.title: Soundness of Zero-Knowledge Proofs over SPARQL Basic Graph Patterns
results.abstract: This paper sketches a zero-knowledge protocol for proving the existence of a BGP match over a committed RDF graph. The construction is presented; a full machine-checked soundness proof is left as future work and the security argument is informal.

results.title: Semi-Honest Multi-Party Computation for Federated Joins
results.abstract: We give a secret-sharing protocol for a two-party federated join. The protocol is secure in the semi-honest model; malicious security is not addressed. We do not claim privacy against an actively corrupted party.
